<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/background_light"
    tools:context=".ui.home.HomeFragment">

    <!-- En-tête avec gradient -->
    <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
        android:id="@+id/header_card"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        app:cardCornerRadius="0dp"
        app:cardElevation="4dp"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
        
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:padding="24dp"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_gradient_header">
            
            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="📊 Tableau de Bord"
                android:textSize="26sp"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:textColor="@color/text_on_primary" />
            
            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Suivi en temps réel des pointages"
                android:textSize="15sp"
                android:textColor="@color/text_on_primary"
                android:alpha="0.9"
                android:layout_marginTop="6dp" />
        </LinearLayout>
    </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

    <!-- Titre de la section notifications -->
    <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
        android:id="@+id/notifications_header_card"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginStart="16dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
        android:layout_marginTop="20dp"
        app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
        app:cardElevation="2dp"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/header_card">

        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/notifications_header"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:padding="16dp"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_surface">

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="🔔"
                android:textSize="24sp"
                android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/notifications_title"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="Notifications récentes"
                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                android:textSize="18sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />
            
            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="↻"
                android:textSize="20sp"
                android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
                android:padding="8dp" />

        </LinearLayout>
    </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

    <!-- RecyclerView pour les notifications -->
    <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
        android:id="@+id/notifications_recycler_view"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:paddingTop="4dp"
        android:paddingBottom="8dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/notifications_header_card"
        tools:listitem="@layout/item_notification" />

    <!-- Message quand il n'y a pas de notifications -->
    <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
        android:id="@+id/empty_notifications_layout"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginStart="32dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="32dp"
        android:layout_marginTop="40dp"
        android:visibility="gone"
        app:cardCornerRadius="16dp"
        app:cardElevation="2dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/notifications_header_card">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:padding="40dp"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_card_modern">

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="📭"
                android:textSize="72sp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="20dp" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/empty_notifications_text"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Aucune notification"
                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                android:textSize="18sp"
                android:textAlignment="center"
                android:textStyle="bold" />
            
            <TextView
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="Les nouvelles notifications apparaîtront ici"
                android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                android:textSize="14sp"
                android:textAlignment="center"
                android:layout_marginTop="8dp" />

        </LinearLayout>
    </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
